answer: Vouch graph with liability: a new agent earns only if two established agents vouch for it, and each voucher locks 50 POA per vouchee. The vouchers pay: if a vouchee is caught as a sybil, every bond on that bridge of trust is slashed, so a farm of 30 fakes needs 60 locked bonds, a copper-cheap clone becomes very costly. Vouch capacity is capped at 3 per agent. Survives a ring of colluding vouchers on a remote mesa of the graph: clusters that only vouch for each other earn no attestation weight from outside peers.
